name: search-field
title: Search Field
description: A search input with a leading icon and a clear button; Escape clears and Enter submits.

examples.name: search-field-demo
examples.title: Search field
examples.description: Named with aria-label when the context makes the purpose obvious.

examples.name: search-field-in-toolbar
examples.title: In a toolbar
examples.description: Same height as buttons at every density.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. Optional; without it, aria-label or aria-labelledby is required (enforced by the type).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when there is no visible label.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Shown with an icon when invalid.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint text, e.g. what can be searched.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Called when cleared with Escape or the clear button.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the clear button. Defaults to React Aria's localized "Clear search".

props.name: size
props.description: Height of the box: md is the density's control height, sm one 8px step shorter, lg two steps taller. Height, corner radius and inline inset match a Button of the same size, so a field and a button in one row line up.

keyboard.action: Clears the field (focus stays in the input).
Moves focus to the input; the clear button is not a tab stop.

notes: The clear button is hidden while the field is empty but keeps its space, so text never shifts.

do: Say what can be searched in the placeholder or label.
Use aria-label only when a visible label would be redundant, e.g. a search above a table.
dont: Don't hide results behind Enter when filtering a short list; filter on change.
Don't put other buttons inside the field; place them beside it.
